proposed_statement.prescribed_objects: For every n:Nat and T:NNReal, Delta_n(T)={0<t1<...<tn<T}, t0=0,t_(n+1)=T. z_j=S_r(Phi_(tj-t_(j-1))(z_(j-1))). Gamma_n,T(t) is the same finite-fold path as law93, post-bounce at internal jumps and last harmonic state at T. gamma denotes its explicit clamped real extension for the hazard integral and incoming limits.
proposed_statement.measures: m_n,T is ordinary product Lebesgue restricted to the strict simplex and represented on its subtype. For n=0 it is the mass-one measure on the empty tuple, including T=0. No factorial is inserted in density or base measure; simplex volume is a separate fact.
proposed_statement.weight: w_n,T(t)=exp(-integral_0^T lambda_r(gamma_n,T(t)(s)) ds) * product_(j=1)^n lambda_r(Phi_(tj-t_(j-1))(z_(j-1))). Density94 identifies the incoming factors with lambda(Gamma(tj-)), and rho=ofReal(w). w is finite and nonnegative. It includes final survival from tn to T.
proposed_statement.observable_quantifiers: For every fixed y,r,z0, every finite T>=0, every real-valued Psi:Path_T->R measurable for coordinate-product sigma, and every finite M>=0 satisfying for all p,abs(Psi(p))<=M. M is source observable boundedness data, not a new process/regularity premise. Equivalent formulation: forall bounded measurable Psi with an internal bound witness.
conclusions: Integrable(Psi composed with Z_T) under P.
For every n, Integrable(t -> Psi(Gamma_n,T(t))*w_n,T(t)) under m_n,T.
The sequence A_n=integral_Delta_n(T) Psi(Gamma_n,T(t))*w_n,T(t) dm_n,T has summable absolute values.

An admissible internal strengthening is sum_n integral_Delta_n(T) abs(Psi(Gamma_n,T(t)))*w_n,T(t) dm_n,T <= M, which supplies both integrability and absolute convergence. It is a derived bound, not an added assumption.
